text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on
the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well hey there, I'm Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any lofty dreams or anything
like
that, but yeaaah, it sure is fun to
surprise
everybody with my running. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll hardly try but—I mean, I'll try
hard, but
let's just take it nice and easy,
'kay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
